help:
• `[prefix]help [command]`
Provides the specific usage mapping and explanation for any given command configuration.
commands:
• `[prefix]commands`
Pulls up the master manual dashboard cataloging all administrative and utility routines.
prefix:
• `[prefix]prefix [new_symbol]`
Alters the global command trigger signature mapping matrix dynamically on the fly.
warn:
• `[prefix]warn @member [reason]`
Vanishes the input, strikes the user history, and dispatches a server-branded DM embed notification card.
unwarn:
• `[prefix]unwarn @member [amount]`
Strips away a specified number of chronological infraction entries cleanly from a member profile ledger.
warns:
• `[prefix]warnings @member`
Audits a user profile chronological strike file registry row-by-row with staff name markers.
clearwarns:
• `[prefix]clearwarns @member`
Wipes a user's local server strike index clean back to zero active infraction entries.
mute:
• `[prefix]mute @member [duration] [reason]`
Vanishes the input and restricts multi-channel communication rights for a locked temporary timeframe window.
unmute:
• `[prefix]unmute @member`
Restores native connection rights immediately. Displays an alert if the user is already unmuted.
kick:
• `[prefix]kick @member [reason]`
Vanishes the input, pushes a server-branded DM layout notification card, and removes the user profile account.
ban:
• `[prefix]ban @member [reason]`
Vanishes the input, pushes a server-branded DM layout notification card, and locks a permanent ban restriction.
unban:
• `[prefix]unban [user_id]`
Strips permanent restriction data entries out of the server security core ledger instantly.
afk:
• `[prefix]afk [reason]`
Flags your account status as away. Automatically calculates away duration windows when you return.
nick:
• `[prefix]nick @member [name]` (or `!n`)
Updates a target member server profile identity namespace assignment instantly.
clearnick:
• `[prefix]clearnick @member` (or `!cn`)
Clears out all custom nickname maps back down to default profile namespace values.
serverinfo:
• `[prefix]serverinfo`
Generates a clean embed detailing server metrics along with a high-resolution profile display card.
r:
• `[prefix]r add/give/remove @member [role keyword]`
Modifies user role structures safely using high-speed fuzzy keyword string identification.
slowmode:
• `[prefix]slowmode [duration/off]`
Engages text stream rate-limiting throttles on the active channel interface lines.
purge:
• `[prefix]purge [amount]` (or `!c` / `!p`)
Bulk deletes a specified block of text channel dialogue rows instantly.
pus:
• `[prefix]pus @member [amount]`
Target purges conversation logs belonging *only* to a single selected account profile.
say:
• `[prefix]say [text]`
Broadcasts an anonymous message text stream directly through the identity profile of the bot.
snipe:
• `[prefix]snipe` (or `!s`)
Recovers the content and author data parameters of the last deleted chat message.
cs:
• `[prefix]cs`
Flushes the local channel message sniper memory log bank clean and reacts with a ✔️.
es:
• `[prefix]es`
Recovers the original text string state of recently edited text chat messages.
ces:
• `[prefix]ces`
Flushes edited message cache collections completely and reacts with a ✔️.
ticket:
• `[prefix]ticket [category] [hex_color] [Title] | [Description text]`
Spawns an interactive multi-department Tickety spawner panel button component loop.
closeticket:
• `[prefix]closeticket` (or `!ct`)
Locks, archives, and deletes an active text help desk support ticket room channel.
